Errors:
CoreErrc::kAlready
Initialized
if the function is called for a framework instance that has already
been successfully initialized
Description:
(Pre-)Initialization of the ARA Framework.
Prior to this call, interaction with the ARA is not allowed with the exception of types intended to
be used independently of initialization as defined in [SWS_CORE_15002]. It is strongly
recommended to make this call in a place where it is guaranteed that static initialization has
completed.
Please note that argc is passed by mutable reference, so both argc and argv may be modified
within the function. This is done to allow injection and interpretation of vendor specific ARA
configuration information. The injected arguments are removed in accordance with
[SWS_CORE_15006].
